content.comment_body: Hello, if I have a PI block where the process value is 110 and the set point is 100, is it possible for the analog output to be below zero (negative)? Thank you.

No, the analog output operates within a range of 0 - 1000, which corresponds to 0 - 10 Volts. Negative values are not supported. In the PI block parameters, you can select either direct (+) or indirect (-) operation for the PI controller. Alternatively, you can use a mathematical instruction block to invert an analog value if needed.

Hello [user_name], please refer to the manual at [url]. Check the section on the PI Controller (page 256) where you will find information about gain, which can only be set to positive values. Best regards, [user_name]
